findings.issue: The two callers still disagree for one class of name, so the stated purpose ('Two answers is how doctor goes green over a name the launcher then refuses', PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md _skill_places section) is only half met. check_plan_skills passes `inventory=` built from `_panel_discovery.discover`, whose scan walks every installed plugin's skills/ (`_plugin_bases`, `_scan_skills(base, 'plugin', ...)`) under bare keys. A bare name that is only some other installed plugin's skill therefore resolves in doctor (source 'scan') and is refused by `run-agent-session` (no inventory), which is the exact green-then-refused shape the task set out to remove. dp52 cannot see it: its inventory (`others`) holds only 'unrelated' and 'scan-only', and neither is in the dp52 name list; dp50 locks the wider mode as 'what doctor saw before'.
findings.resolution: Either drop the inventory mode for bare names the session would not load, or keep it but say so: when `resolve_skill` returns source 'scan', have doctor word the row as 'found only by the machine scan at <path>; `run-agent-session --skill` will refuse it', and add a dp52 name that only the inventory lists, asserting doctor and the launcher answers differ visibly rather than silently.

findings.issue: The diff reverses the launcher's order to personal-before-project, but the portability grade in `_plan_skills_travel` is still read from `have.get(name)`, the scan entry, and the scan dedupes project before user ('project/user scanned before plugins win', `_discover_scan` scans `.claude` of the project first). For a name held by both, doctor's resolved path is now the personal copy while `travels`/`travelsBasis` describe the project copy: a plan can be graded 'travels' over a file the session does not load. The executor names this in the outcome and leaves it for another task, but it is created by this change (before it, launcher and scan agreed on project-first).
findings.resolution: In `_plan_skills_travel`, compare `entry.get('path')` with `resolved[name]['path']` and, when they differ, put the name in `unknown` with both paths named (the grade belongs to a different file than the one loaded), or make the scan's project/user order match `_skill_places`. Add a dp case with the same name in both tiers.

findings.issue: The note that `claude --help` does not list `--append-system-prompt-file`, with the probe's build and date, sits in the module docstring (line 35). The only place the flag is written in code (`session_argv`, line 217) carries no comment, and ras50 reads 700 characters around the FIRST occurrence of the string only, which is the docstring. The task asked for it 'beside the flag'.
findings.resolution: Add a one-line comment above `argv += ["--append-system-prompt-file", skills_file]` pointing at the docstring probe (claude 2.1.307, 2026-10-23), and have ras50 check the last occurrence as well.
